name: awesome-embedded-systems
desc: A curated list of delightful Embedded Systems libraries, RTOSes, modules, references and more!

resources.name: lwIP
resources.desc: lwIP is a small independent implementation of the TCP/IP protocol suite that has been initially developed by Adam Dunkels. Supports DHCP with AutoIP fallback, UDP, TCP, and an interrupt driven model.

resources.name: uIP
resources.desc: A very tiny IP stack, but also a very minimal IP stack. (Not maintained anymore)

resources.name: cantcoap
resources.desc: Small and lightweight coap encoder and decoder. Protocol level stuff is left to the user.

resources.name: libcoap
resources.desc: libcoap implements a lightweight application-protocol for devices that are constrained their resources such as computing power, RF range, memory, bandwith, or network packet sizes

resources.name: microcoap
resources.desc: A small CoAP implementation for microcontrollers

resources.name: libnyoci
resources.desc: A flexible CoAP stack for embedded devices and computers. RFC7252 compatible.

resources.name: CanFestival
resources.desc: CanFestival focuses on providing an ANSI-C platform independent CANopen® stack that can be built as master or slave nodes on PCs, Real-time IPCs, and Microcontrollers.

resources.name: CANopenNode
resources.desc: CANopenNode is written in ANSI C in object-oriented way. It runs on different microcontrollers, as standalone application or with RTOS.

resources.name: Lely CANopen Library
resources.desc: A CANopen implementation for both masters and slaves written in C, but with a C++ interface.

resources.name: nanopb
resources.desc: Nanopb is a plain-C implementation of Google's Protocol Buffers data format. It is targeted at 32 bit microcontrollers, but is also fit for other embedded systems with tight (2-10 kB ROM, <1 kB RAM) memory constraints.

resources.name: mpack
resources.desc: A C encoder/decoder for MessagePack messages suitable for resource constriants embedded systems. Supports disabling dynamic memory allocation and overriding malloc, free, and realloc.

resources.name: tinycbor
resources.desc: Intel's implementation of CBOR designed for their IOT-based applications and processors

resources.name: bitproto
resources.desc: A fast, lightweight and easy-to-use bit level data interchange format for serializing data structure. Its syntax is similar to protobuf, but very suitable for the embedded systems.

resources.name: json-build
resources.desc: A tiny, zero-allocation JSON serializer written in ANSI C. A good fit for development in memory constrained systems.

resources.name: TinyOS
resources.desc: A operating system designed for low-power wireless devices, such as those used in sensor networks, ubiquitous computing, personal area networks, smart buildings, and smart meters.

resources.name: ContikiOS
resources.desc: A free Operating System with focus to provide standardized low-power wireless communication for a wide range of hardware platforms.

resources.name: FreeRTOS
resources.desc: A free use Real Time Operating system which is widely used and supports a large number of platforms.

resources.name: RIOT
resources.desc: A free OS for IoT devices providing foundational trust services. The trust services include device identity, sealing, attestation, and data integrity. The term “Robust” is used because the minimal trusted computing base is tiny, and because RIoT capabilities can remotely re-establish trust in devices that have been compromised by malware.

resources.name: RTEMS
resources.desc: Real-Time Executive for Multiprocessor Systems or RTEMS is an open source Real Time Operating System (RTOS) that supports open standard application programming interfaces (API) such as POSIX. It is used in space flight, medical, networking and many more embedded devices using processor architectures including ARM, PowerPC, Intel, Blackfin, MIPS, Microblaze and more.

resources.name: SafeRTOS
resources.desc: Certified version of FreeRTOS by TUEV SUED against IEC 61508 (basic functional safety standard) up to SIL3 (the highest safety integrity level for a single software component), ISO 26262 ASIL D (automotive standard) and EN62304 (medical device standard).

resources.name: INTEGRITY/INTEGRITY-178
resources.desc: Two commercial RTOS variants targeting to power embedded systems with total reliability, absolute security, and maximum real-time performance. The variant INTEGRYTY-178 has a lot of safety and security certifications.

resources.name: PikeOS
resources.desc: A commercial micro-kernel based operating system with a small footprint and certified for DO-178 (avionics), IEC-61508 (industrial), ISO-26262 (automotive).

resources.name: Rocket
resources.desc: A free embedded operating system specifically designed to quickly and easily build small, intelligent devices in Wind Rivers cloud-based development environment, Wind River Helix™ App Cloud.

resources.name: Nucleus RTOS
resources.desc: Commercial, highly scalable micro-kernel based real-time operating system designed for scalability and reliability.

resources.name: uC/os
resources.desc: µC/OS-II and µC/OS-III are preemptive, highly portable, and scalable real-time kernels. You can test them out for free, but you must pay to put them into a product.

resources.name: CppUTest
resources.desc: unit testing and mocking framework for C/C++ with a focus on working for embedded systems!

resources.name: ceedling, unity and cmock
resources.desc: Unit testing, mocking and build framework written in C with ruby for generating and building.

resources.name: doctest
resources.desc: A lightweight and feature-rich C++98/C++11 single-header testing framework for unit tests and TDD.

resources.name: Mockitopp
resources.desc: A C++ mocking framework inspired by the ideas developed for Mockito written by Szczepan Faber, et al. The purpose is to provide similar construction semantics for creating mock objects leading to smaller, more readable test cases. It is designed to be a lightweight framework allowing you to mock dependencies for a system under test using a simple descriptive domain specific language. The goal is to help create simpler, less brittle test cases; ultimately, leading to less maintenance overhead in the future.

resources.name: Trompeloeil
resources.desc: A thread safe header only mocking framework for C++14 using the Boost Software License 1.0

resources.name: Catch
resources.desc: A modern, C++-native, header-only, test framework for unit-tests, TDD and BDD - using C++11, C++14, C++17 and later (or C++03 on the Catch1.x branch)

resources.name: AREG SDK
resources.desc: An interface-centric real-time asynchronous communication engine for embedded and high-end applications to enable distributed- and mist-computing, where connected Things interact and provide services, as if they act like thin distributed servers.

resources.name: ARM mbed
resources.desc: The ARM mbed IoT Device Platform provides the operating system, cloud services, tools and developer ecosystem to make the creation and deployment of commercial, standards-based IoT solutions possible at scale.

resources.name: minilibd
resources.desc: "This collection has libraries and tools to compile D language programs for embedded or "bare metal" systems with the

resources.name: DConf 2014 Talk "Tiny, Ubiquitous Machines Powered by D"
resources.desc: Presentation about D in tiny embedded systems.

resources.name: hubris
resources.desc: A lightweight, memory-protected, message-passing kernel for deeply embedded systems.

resources.name: rust-embedded
resources.desc: RFCs proposed by the Rust community for better embedded systems support.

resources.name: embed.rs
resources.desc: Articles about doing embedded on rust

resources.name: Nerves
resources.desc: Uses buildroot to deploy Elixir programs running on the Erlang VM to embedded linux boards

resources.name: AdaCore
resources.desc: Open source maintainer of Ada with a focus on embedded use.

resources.name: Tessel
resources.desc: A openWRT based embedded system which can run Javascript.

resources.name: JerryScript
resources.desc: A JavaScript engine intended to run on a very constrained devices such as microcontrollers. Designed for the Internet of Things.

resources.name: Nim
resources.desc: A statically-typed programming language inspired by Python, Ada and Modula that compiles to C, C++, and Javascript.

resources.name: Ferrett
resources.desc: Ferret is a free software Clojure implementation for real time embedded control systems.

resources.name: GERT
resources.desc: GERT is a modified version of Go that runs bare-metal on armv7a SOCs. The minimal set of OS primitives that Go relies on have been re-implemented entirely in Go and Plan 9 assembly inside the modified runtime. The goal of this project is to bring the benefits of a high-level, type-safe, and garbage-collected language to bare-metal embedded environments.

resources.name: ESTL
resources.desc: C++ STL-like library for embedded developers with C++ 98 features only to maximize target platform compatibility.

resources.name: ETL
resources.desc: Embedded Template Library which offers compile time defined container sizes, full C++ 03 and partial C++ 11 compatibility, deterministic behaviour, additional components for the embedded domain, etc.

resources.name: uSTL
resources.desc: Partial, code size implementation of the STL.

resources.name: EASTL
resources.desc: Electronic Arts STL - aimed for console devices. Good descripton avaliable HERE

resources.name: Single File Libs
resources.desc: Single File libraries for C++ and C. Some might be useful for embedded systems use.

resources.name: Embedded
resources.desc: Elicia White and Christopher White interview makes, hackers and engineers who work on embedded systems

resources.name: Two's Complement Podcast
resources.desc: Discussions between Matt Godbolt and Ben Rady, revolving around testing, best practices, etc in C and C++ development.

resources.name: Interrupt
resources.desc: Great in-depth blog posts from MemFault. Mostly around ARM Cortex-M series processors.

resources.name: Embedsys Weekly
resources.desc: A weekly selection of embedded software and hardware articles.

resources.name: EEVBlog
resources.desc: More on the electronics side, but David L. Jones tears apart embedded systems and electronic devices.

resources.name: The Signal Path
resources.desc: Electronics equipment teardowns

resources.name: Making Embedded Systems by Elicia White
resources.desc: Covers the basics of embedded systems architecture, design and patterns.

resources.name: Test Driven Developmet for Embedded C by James Grenning
resources.desc: How to approach test driven development for embedded devices written in C.

resources.name: uC/OS-III, The Real-Time Kernel by Jean J Labrosse
resources.desc: A book about the Micrium's uC/os III. It is a great resource on how RTOSes for embedded systems should work.

resources.name: An Embedded Software Primer by David E. Simon
resources.desc: An introduction to embedded systems, with a good explanation to Real-time operating systems(RTOS).

resources.name: Embedded C Coding Standards
resources.desc: Coding standards for embedded C from the Barr Group.

resources.name: SEI CERT C Coding Standard
resources.desc: The SEI CERT C Coding Standard is a software coding standard for the C programming language to improve the safety, reliability, and security of software systems.

resources.name: PlatformIO
resources.desc: PlatformIO is an open source ecosystem for IoT development

resources.name: Energia
resources.desc: Energia is an open-source electronics prototyping platform, it brings the Wiring and Arduino framework to the Texas Instruments MSP430 based LaunchPad, it includes an IDE that is based on Processing.

resources.name: XOD
resources.desc: An open source visual programming platform for Arduino-compatible boards.

resources.name: yocto
resources.desc: Yocto is a tool for creating custom embedded linux systems

resources.name: Buildroot
resources.desc: Buildroot is a simple, efficient and easy-to-use tool to generate embedded Linux systems through cross-compilation.

resources.name: Mender
resources.desc: Open source over-the-air (OTA) software updater for embedded Linux devices.

resources.name: SWUpdate
resources.desc: Linux Update agent with the goal to provide an efficient and safe way to update (local, remote, multiple update strategies) an embedded system.
